business.description: Omnipotent Industries Limited reported nil revenue from operations for FY 2025-26 and a loss of Rs 39.76 lakh. The company had revenue of Rs 2,013.48 lakh in FY 2024-25.

products.name: Bitumen 60/70 & 80/100, VG10, VG30, VG40; bitumen emulsion, blown bitumen, micro surfacing bitumen, modified bitumen CRMB, PMB, NRMB
products.note: Only one reportable segment: Bitumen products

products.name: Bitumen products
products.note: Company is trading of bitumen products only

geographies.name: Export markets (neighboring countries, Africa, Southeast Asia)

risks: Crude oil price volatility affecting procurement costs and margins
Supply chain and logistics disruptions (shipping, refinery shutdowns, geopolitical events)
Intense competition from organized manufacturers, importers, and regional traders
Increasing environmental regulations requiring additional capex and compliance costs
Execution delays in infrastructure projects (land acquisition, funding, weather, approvals)
Foreign exchange risk from imports and exports
Interest rate and inflationary pressures on financing, transportation, energy, raw materials
Climate-related risks (extreme weather, prolonged monsoon) slowing road construction
GST liabilities of Rs. 34.75 Lacs under appeal
Show cause notice received, paid ₹132 lakhs under DRC-03 to safeguard company interest
Trade receivables include Rs. 73,735 thousand unsecured, not considered good (more than 180 days)
Disputed trade payables of Rs. 12,817 thousand
Loss on disposal of inventory and fixed assets
